Video Training

Master Every Step, Effortlessly

Clear training videos to help your team handle Innovive cages and racks with confidence.https://youtu.be/ewEvm47ua5c?si=lzqKrmlT5cSBllFI

Opening / Closing the Cage

This video demonstrates how to open and close the Innocage® for right-handed or left-handed cage handlers.https://youtu.be/a-7iBOcfiCQ?si=-jnCMAOgX6YyGiz5

Disposable Cages Pre Filled Water Bottle Preparation

This video demonstrates how to properly prepare an Aquavive® pre-filled water bottle. https://youtu.be/622eXARRz_g?si=nWyoMqOLV119cKxv

Mouse Bottom-Only Changeout Procedure

Learn how to perform a Innocage® Mouse bottom-only cage change, reusing lid, feeder, and the water bottle. https://vimeo.com/595536487?fl=pl&fe=cm

Rat Bottom-Only Changeout Procedure

Learn how to perform a Innocage® Rat bottom-only cage change, reusing lid, feeder, and the water bottle.https://youtu.be/-zzybXxgCrc?si=-7U4MB8xiLMHUErB

Docking/Undocking the Cage

Learn how to properly dock and undock the Innocage® from the Innorack.https://youtu.be/71-PfhwWV2U?si=Lf3KFCz5J3hJRp6x

Placing/Removing the Cage Card Holder

This video shows how to place/remove the card holder from the front of the Innocage®.https://youtu.be/K_Q9iXQwlPw?si=2eRcM2UYkDeH_4fK

Innocage® Autowatering: Grommet Insertion

This video demonstrates how to insert and remove the grommet from Innovive autowatering-ready cage.https://youtu.be/Xt0wENse1uw?si=bTUwhErytqwj2p0y

Innorack Controller: Airflow Adjustments

This video demonstrates how to change airflow settings on the controller.https://youtu.be/Xt0wENse1uw?si=3ok1B8Dv4-GYuHFX

Innorack Controller: Configuration Settings

This video demonstrates how to change controller configurations. https://youtu.be/FyW63oV2H4k?si=ossVAvTcWIbV53RO

Innorack Controller: Blower Calibration Procedure

This video demonstrates how to lock and unlock the controller screen. https://youtu.be/FyW63oV2H4k?si=9DhCmAUIU6_C3Eyq

Innorack Controller: Locking/Unlocking the Screen

This video demonstrates how to lock and unlock the controller screen.https://vimeo.com/595536242?fl=pl&fe=cm

Docking/Undocking the Innorack v3.5 Blowers

This video demonstrates how to properly dock and undock the Innorack v3.5 blowers.https://vimeo.com/790233539?fl=pl&fe=cm

Innorack v3.5 Supply Blower Pre-Filter Replacement Procedure

This video demonstrates how to replace the v3.5 Supply Blower pre-filter.https://youtu.be/n8O7pfAqpRs?si=j4TpR2rs-_8SFivf

Docking/Undocking the Innorack v3.0 Blowers

This video demonstrates how to properly dock and undock the Innorack v3.0 blowers.https://youtu.be/IZDs6antWaI?si=CXd-QPFSHNTt9Npb

Innorack v3.0 Supply Blower Pre-Filter Replacement Procedure

This video demonstrates how to replace the v3.0 Supply Blower pre-filter.https://youtu.be/0IdyjbYNyAA?si=kPKJpaRK6Xhy-87W

Innorack v3.0 Supply HEPA Filter Replacement Procedure

This video demonstrates how to replace the v3.0 Supply HEPA filter.https://youtu.be/CgsMDZN7Nh4?si=Nicg3wpGACQWHBVp

Innorack 3.5 Controller Dimming/Sleep Feature

This video demonstrates how to set up the Innorack 3.5 controller dimming/sleep feature.https://youtu.be/r86y9r-Gksw?si=sbHEecmi9nHB1AeN

Innocage® Mouse Metabolic Cage Assembly

This video demonstrates how to assemble the Innocage® Mouse Metabolic Cage Assemblyhttps://video.wixstatic.com/video/9709ce_edaf8828284744998581ebcd7021644f/720p/mp4/file.mp4

The Innovive Mouse Ladder (M-CLIMB)

A versatile enrichment tool used for climbing and transferring mice during cage changes.
